# BloonsPlus Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

BloonsPlus should be a welcoming place to ask questions, share strategies and build software. Treat people respectfully regardless of experience, age, disability, background, identity or beliefs. Critique an idea or a change without attacking its author.

## Expected behavior

- Be patient with newcomers and people who communicate differently.
- Give specific, constructive feedback and make room for other views.
- Respect privacy, boundaries and a person's decision to disengage.
- Credit others' work and follow licensing and project rules.
- Accept moderation decisions and discuss concerns calmly through private channels.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, threats, hate speech, sexual harassment, personal attacks, deliberate intimidation, impersonation, doxxing, publishing private information without consent, and repeated disruptive spam are not allowed. Retaliation against a person who reports a concern is not allowed. Continuing unwanted contact after being asked to stop is also a violation.

## Scope

This policy applies to repository issues, pull requests and other BloonsPlus project spaces, including the official Discord. It also applies when someone represents the project publicly. It does not make maintainers responsible for every unrelated private interaction.

## Reporting a concern

Privately contact the owner **klaasa** or project staff through the [official Discord](https://discord.gg/qxUGXqrXsY). Include a short account of what happened, relevant links and the minimum evidence needed. Do not post sensitive evidence in public issues or channels. For behavior on GitHub, you can also use [GitHub's abuse reporting tools](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam).

Reports will be handled discreetly. Information is shared only as needed to investigate, act or meet applicable obligations; absolute confidentiality cannot be promised. Security vulnerabilities use the separate [security policy](SECURITY.md).

## Enforcement and review

Maintainers may remove content, close or lock a discussion, issue a warning, limit participation temporarily, or ban an account. The response should reflect the severity, repetition and impact of the behavior. Serious threats or privacy violations may require immediate restrictions without a prior warning.

Affected people may ask for a private review through the same contact channel and provide relevant context. Maintainers should avoid handling a report in which they have a direct conflict of interest when another moderator is available. Moderation must not be used to silence respectful technical disagreement.
